context: Tests whether the agent handles exceptions according to DbC rules, specifically by restoring the class invariant before failing or resuming, and ensuring validation.

checklist.name: Exception identification
checklist.description: Uses a try/except block to catch potential failures in the sub-tasks.

checklist.name: Invariant restoration
checklist.description: Explicitly restores the class invariant (e.g. balance consistency) in the except block.

checklist.name: Validation after restoration
checklist.description: Calls a class invariant check or a validated property immediately after state restoration in the handler.

checklist.name: Organized Panic
checklist.description: Follows the Organized Panic strategy by reporting failure after restoring the invariant.

checklist.name: Class Invariant check
checklist.description: Demonstrates knowledge of the class invariant being maintained even in error states.

checklist.name: Native Assertions
checklist.description: Uses native assertions (e.g., assert) to enforce the invariant.
